question: According to the India State of Forest Report 2021, ________ group covers 4,992 km2 of the total geographical area.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mangroves**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Mangroves covered 4,992 km2 of the total geographical area according to the India State of Forest Report 2021.
 
• Mangroves are crucial for coastal protection, biodiversity conservation, and as a carbon sink.
